facilities: Free Security Cloakroom & Lockers for mobile phones and personal belongings.
Free Footwear Counter at the hill base.
Clean Drinking Water Kiosks & Shaded Seating Benches.
Prasad & Sweet Counter near the exit gate.
B.M. Birla Planetarium, Science Museum & Dinosaurium located on the adjacent hillock (Kala Pahad).
Paid Vehicle Parking Area near Hill Fort Road entrance.

Wheelchair Accessibility: There is a lift, but the catch is one has to climb 25 steps to get to the lift. Upon checking there is a wheel chair to get to the lift. But the wheel chair has to be carried and the people who carry the wheel chair will be there till 2pm. So, if any one who plan to take a darshan, do so before 2pm or make sure till what time the helpers are there to carry the wheel chair. THERE IS NO RAMP TO PUSH THE WHEEL CHAIR. Then there are about 30 more steps atleast to take the lords darshan. No lift or ramp access.
